definitions: Certificates of debt issued by a government or company to raise money, promising to pay a specified sum at a fixed date in the future and to pay interest at regular intervals.
The forces or links that unite people or things.
A written agreement by which a person is legally bound to pay a sum of money or to perform a particular action.
Chains or fetters used to restrict movement.
examples: Government bonds are considered a safe investment.
The bonds of friendship are strong.
He was released on bail bonds.
The prisoner was held in bonds.
